normalIntro.en: Terrific carries the Latin fear stem terr- and the making suffix -fic, so it once meant fear-making.
normalIntro.cn: terrific 带着拉丁语恐惧词干 terr- 与「造成」后缀 -fic，原义是「制造恐惧的」。

normal.en: Terrific and terror share the terr- stem that Latin used for fright.
normal.cn: terrific 与 terror 共享拉丁语表示恐惧的 terr- 词干。

normal.en: The suffix -fic in terrific is the same -fic we see in scientific and prolific.
normal.cn: terrific 里的 -fic 与 scientific、prolific 中的 -fic 同源，表示「造成」。

normal.en: The phrase a terrific idea shows how the word became praise for a bright plan.
normal.cn: 搭配 a terrific idea 显示它已变成对好主意的称赞。

normal.en: A terrific amount keeps the older force of size, not only approval.
normal.cn: a terrific amount 保留了「分量大」的旧底子，不只是夸好。

normal.en: Compare terrible: terrible stayed with bad news, while terrific crossed over to good news.
normal.cn: 对比 terrible：terrible 留在坏消息一侧，而 terrific 跨到了好消息一侧。

abstract.en: Picture a fireworks burst so bright that the crowd forgets to speak.
abstract.cn: 想象烟花炸得太亮，人群一时说不出话来。

abstract.en: Imagine a giant wave rising and somehow looking beautiful instead of scary.
abstract.cn: 想象一道巨浪升起，却奇妙地显得壮美而非可怕。

abstract.en: Think of an old storyteller hushing children with a storm at sea that is somehow thrilling.
abstract.cn: 想象老说书人用一场海上风暴吓住孩子，那场面却令人兴奋。

examples.en: She did a terrific job of organising the exhibition.
examples.cn: 她把展览组织得极为出色。

examples.en: We had a terrific time at the beach.
examples.cn: 我们在海滩上玩得非常开心。

examples.en: Old records speak of a terrific storm that struck the harbour.
examples.cn: 旧记载提到一场袭击港口的可怕风暴。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特瑞菲克」——特级品质、瑞气满门，自然是极好的；这只是拆音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 terrere（使恐惧）+ -ficus（造成，源自 facere）→ terrificus（制造恐惧的）→ 英语 terrific，核心义「引起惊恐」→「猛烈得吓人的」→「极好的」。

sensesIntro.en: Terrific starts by naming what makes us afraid, swells into enormous force, and finally turns that peak of intensity into praise.
sensesIntro.cn: terrific 从「令人害怕」出发，胀大成「巨大的力量」，最后把这份极点般的强烈用来表达称赞。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a burst of light so strong that people look up and gasp.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束亮到让人仰头屏息的爆炸或光芒。

branches.en: Praise is the newest branch, where intensity becomes approval.
branches.cn: 称赞是最新的分支，强烈程度转成了认可。

branches.en: Size is the oldest part of the trunk, still visible in a terrific amount.
branches.cn: 「分量大」是主干最老的一环，在 a terrific amount 里仍看得见。

branches.en: The literal sense of causing fear survives mainly in older writing.
branches.cn: 「令人恐惧」的字面义主要残留在旧文本中。

branches.en: Amount and force sit side by side, since both describe something nearly overwhelming.
branches.cn: 数量与力量并排生长，两者说的都是几乎压过人的东西。

branches.en: Once force itself is the impression, a plain degree word is born.
branches.cn: 一旦力量本身就是全部印象，一个纯粹的强调词就诞生了。

intro.en: Terrific is built from the Latin stem terr- plus the making suffix -fic and the adjective ending -ic.
intro.cn: terrific 由拉丁语词干 terr- 加「造成」后缀 -fic 与形容词词尾 -ic 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin terrere means to frighten, and its participle territus feeds English word after word about fear.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 terrere 意为使恐惧，其分词 territus 为英语一连串恐惧类词提供原料。

items.example: The root terr- is shared with terror and terrify.
items.exampleCN: 词根 terr- 与 terror、terrify 共享。

items.example: Terror names the feeling behind the root.
items.exampleCN: terror 把这个词根背后的感受写成一个名词。

items.example: Terrify adds the verb suffix -ify to the same stem.
items.exampleCN: terrify 在同一词干上加动词后缀 -ify。

items.example: Terrifying keeps the original force of the root.
items.exampleCN: terrifying 保留了词根原本的恐惧力量。

items.example: The suffix -fic in terrific carries the sense of making.
items.exampleCN: terrific 中的后缀 -fic 含有「造成」的意思。

items.example: Terrific passed from dreadful to marvellous.
items.exampleCN: terrific 从「可怕」一路走到了「绝妙」。

items.example: Terrifically adds the adverb suffix -ally.
items.exampleCN: terrifically 加了副词后缀 -ally。

items.example: Terrible shares -ible and the terr- stem but not the suffix -fic.
items.exampleCN: terrible 与 terrific 共享 terr- 词干，但结尾是 -ible 而非 -fic。

items.example: The prefix de- and the terr- stem together build deterrent.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 de- 与 terr- 词干合起来构成 deterrent。

definition_zh: 使恐惧；吓唬；使万分害怕
definition_en: to make someone feel extremely frightened
core_image: 夜路上忽然有人从树后跳出来，你浑身一僵
scene: 暴雨夜里，山里的小路一片漆黑，同伴的手电突然熄灭了，四周只剩风声。Something moving in the dark began to terrify the whole group.
sceneCN: 这里 terrify 是「使万分害怕」（第 1 个义项：让人强烈地感到恐惧）；句意：黑暗中的某个东西开始让整队人害怕起来。

pos.zh: 及物动词：使恐惧；吓唬；使万分害怕

derivatives.zh: 由动词加后缀 -ing 构成，义为「吓人的；令人恐惧的」
由动词过去分词转成形容词，义为「恐惧的；吓坏了的」
与动词同根，由 terr- 加名词后缀 -or 构成，义为「恐怖；极度恐惧」
由 terror 加名词后缀 -ism 构成，义为「恐怖主义」

senses.title: To make someone extremely afraid
senses.definition: to fill a person with intense fear
senses.definitionCN: 让某人陷入强烈的恐惧之中
senses.example: The silence in the empty house began to terrify her.
senses.exampleCN: 空房子里的一片寂静开始让她害怕。
senses.why: Latin terrere means to frighten, and the verb suffix -ify means to make, so terrify literally means to make someone afraid.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 terrere 意为使恐惧，动词后缀 -ify 表示「使成为」，所以 terrify 字面上就是「让人害怕」。

senses.title: To frighten someone into obeying
senses.definition: to scare someone so much that they give in or obey
senses.definitionCN: 把人吓得顺从或让步
senses.example: The gang tried to terrify the shopkeepers into paying for protection.
senses.exampleCN: 那伙人想吓住店主，让他们交保护费。
senses.why: Fear is a tool of control, so the verb also names the act of using fright to make people submit.
senses.whyCN: 恐惧本身可以用来控制人，所以这个动词也指用惊吓逼迫别人就范。

senses.title: To cause a place to feel frightening
senses.definition: to give a place or situation a frightening quality
senses.definitionCN: 让某个地方或情形带上可怕的性质
senses.example: Low clouds and long shadows terrify the old cemetery after dark.
senses.exampleCN: 天黑后，低云和长长的影子让这座老墓地显得十分可怕。
senses.why: The object need not be a person: anything that puts fear on a place can be its target.
senses.whyCN: 宾语不一定是人：任何能给某个地方蒙上恐惧的东西都可以做它的宾语。

senses.title: To fill with dread about a future event
senses.definition: to make someone feel dread or deep worry about what may happen
senses.definitionCN: 让人对未来可能发生的事心生忧惧
senses.example: The thought of the oral exam terrifies most candidates.
senses.exampleCN: 一想到口试，大多数考生就心生惧怕。
senses.why: Imagined danger works like real danger, so the verb stretches to cover fear of what has not yet happened.
senses.whyCN: 想象出来的危险和真实的危险一样能吓到人，所以这个词也扩展到对尚未发生之事的忧惧。

senses.title: To be scared of something
senses.definition: in the passive, to be extremely afraid of a thing or situation
senses.definitionCN: 用于被动式，表示非常害怕某人或某物
senses.example: As a child, he was terrified of thunderstorms.
senses.exampleCN: 小时候，他特别怕雷雨天。
senses.why: The passive be terrified describes the state left behind, so the verb turns into an adjective of strong fear.
senses.whyCN: 被动形式 be terrified 描述被惊吓后留下的状态，动词就这样变成表示强烈恐惧的形容词。

intro.en: Terrify comes from Latin terrificare, formed from territus, the participle of terrere, to frighten, plus -ficare, to make.
intro.cn: terrify 来自拉丁语 terrificare，由 terrere（使恐惧）的分词 territus 加 -ficare（使……、造成）构成。

items.en: Terrere means to frighten, and its participle territus means frightened.
items.cn: terrere 意为使恐惧，其分词 territus 意为「受惊的」。

items.en: The suffix -ficare, from facere, to make, turns the stem into a verb of causing.
items.cn: 后缀 -ficare 源自 facere（做、造），把词干变成表示「造成」的动词。

items.en: Terrificare means to make someone afraid, and it enters the learned vocabulary of the church and schools.
items.cn: terrificare 意为使人害怕，进入了教堂与学堂的书面词汇。

items.en: French terrifier carries the learned verb toward English usage.
items.cn: 法语 terrifier 把这个书面动词进一步带向英语。

items.en: English first records terrify in the sense of frightening people thoroughly.
items.cn: 英语最早记录的 terrify，就是「把人彻底吓住」的意思。

items.en: The passive be terrified fixes the word as the everyday verb of strong fear.
items.cn: 现代英语的被动式 be terrified 让它固定在日常表达强烈恐惧的位置上。

note.en: Terrify belongs to the terr- family of fear words and sits among verbs that turn fright into action.
note.cn: terrify 属于 terr- 恐惧词族，与一组把恐惧变成动作的动词相邻。

normal.en: Terrify shares the terr- stem with terror and terrible.
normal.cn: terrify 与 terror、terrible 共享 terr- 词干。

normal.en: The suffix -ify in terrify also builds simplify and purify, all meaning to make something.
normal.cn: terrify 的 -ify 也见于 simplify 与 purify，都表示「使变成」。

normal.en: The passive be terrified of is the everyday frame for a strong fear.
normal.cn: 被动搭配 be terrified of 是表达强烈害怕的常用框架。

normal.en: Terrifying describes the cause, while terrified describes the person it happens to.
normal.cn: terrifying 形容让人害怕的事物，terrified 形容被吓到的人。
